name: Add Note
description: Adds a new note. For info on [adding an note in Pipedrive](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Notes#addNote)

configurable_props.name: content
configurable_props.label: Content
configurable_props.description: The content of the note in HTML format. Subject to sanitization on the back-end.

configurable_props.name: leadId
configurable_props.label: Lead ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the lead the note will be attached to. This property is required unless one of (deal_id/person_id/org_id) is specified.

configurable_props.name: dealId
configurable_props.label: Deal ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the deal the note will be attached to. This property is required unless one of (lead_id/person_id/org_id) is specified.

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the person this note will be attached to. This property is required unless one of (deal_id/lead_id/org_id) is specified.

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the organization this note will be attached to. This property is required unless one of (deal_id/lead_id/person_id) is specified.

configurable_props.name: userId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the user who will be marked as the author of the note. Only an admin can change the author.

configurable_props.name: addTime
configurable_props.label: Add Time
configurable_props.description: The creation date and time of the deal. Requires admin user API token. Format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`

configurable_props.name: pinnedToDealFlag
configurable_props.label: Pinned To Deal Flag
configurable_props.description: If set, the results are filtered by note to deal pinning state (deal_id is also required)

configurable_props.name: pinnedToLeadFlag
configurable_props.label: Pinned To Lead Flag
configurable_props.description: If set, the results are filtered by note to lead pinning state (lead_id is also required)

configurable_props.name: pinnedToOrgFlag
configurable_props.label: Pinned To Organization Flag
configurable_props.description: If set, the results are filtered by note to organization pinning state (org_id is also required)

configurable_props.name: pinnedToPersonFlag
configurable_props.label: Pinned To Person Flag
configurable_props.description: If set, the results are filtered by note to person pinning state (person_id is also required)
